observations: Blue industrial electric motor with ribbed casing.
Red coupling shaft protruding from the bottom.
A metal identification plate is mounted on the side.
The motor shows significant surface rust and paint peeling.
The plate is covered in dirt and grime, obscuring the text.
The motor is sitting on a wet concrete surface.

claims.evidence: The technical plate in photo 1 and 2 lists a rated power of 1.1 kW.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may not be able to reach or maintain its rated speed.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running at 1400 rpm.

risks.risk: The shaft may be seized or have excessive play.
risks.proof: A video showing the shaft rotating freely.

risks.risk: The internal windings may be damaged or have high resistance.
risks.proof: A multimeter reading of the winding resistance.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the motor running to confirm it reaches 1400 rpm.
Video of the shaft rotating to check for play.
Multimeter reading of the winding resistance.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
